summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch recalled the history of Mozart Hall at Broadway and Biddle Street, naming Tom Allen among the renowned fighters who boxed there during its riotous 1868-1874 era.

metadata.notes: masthead: Thursday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, April 29, 1897, page 12; headline "Will Leave an Historic Spot"

facts.fact: Allen was among the well-known fighters who boxed at Mozart Hall, Broadway and Biddle Street, St. Louis, between 1868 and 1874, along with Ned O'Baldwin, Joe Coburn, Jem Mace, Mike McCoole and Charley Gallagher
places: Mozart Hall, Broadway and Biddle Street, St. Louis

notes: retrospective; date range 1868-1874 given only as an era, recorded as 1868
